name: Discover it Cash Back
balance_transfer_fee: 3% on amounts transferred within the first 15 months; 5% on transfers posted at a promotional APR offered later

welcome_bonus.bonus: Cashback Match, which doubles every dollar of cash back you earn in your first year
welcome_bonus.requirement: automatic on all cash back earned from account approval through your first 365 days, with no minimum spend and no cap, paid within two billing periods

verdict.text: The 5% categories pay well, if you remember to activate them

earn_rates.category: Rotating quarterly categories, up to the quarterly maximum, once you activate

earn_note: The 5% runs up to a quarterly maximum and only pays if you activate first. Forget, and the quarter earns 1%. The product page gives no dollar figure, but Capital One's migration FAQ says $1,500 a quarter for Discover it Cash Back. Discover's category calendar has been offline since August 2026, so treat any category list you find as unconfirmed.

redemption_options.method: Partner gift cards, which carry at least 5% added value
Statement credit or deposit to a bank account

points.note: Cash back is worth a flat 1 cent as a statement credit or a bank deposit, with no minimum and no expiration while the account is open. The part most comparisons miss is gift cards: Discover guarantees at least 5% added value on partner gift cards, so $47.50 of rewards buys a $50 card, and rotating merchant promotions have gone as high as 15% to 25% on names like Apple, Uber, Instacart, Chipotle and GameStop. Treat the 5% as the floor you can count on and the bigger promotions as opportunistic, since they are merchant-specific and time-limited. One catch worth knowing: the minimum gift card redemption rose from $5 to $25 when accounts moved to Capital One.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners. Cashback Bonus is cash, not a transferable currency.

protection_note: There is nothing here, and that is the honest answer rather than a gap in our research. Discover dropped purchase protection, extended warranty, return guarantee, auto rental coverage and travel accident insurance at the end of February 2018, then price protection that October, and the current cardmember agreement contains no benefit terms of any kind. That makes Discover unusual among big US issuers: even most no-fee cards from Chase, Capital One and Citi still carry a purchase protection or extended warranty row. What Discover does spend its money on is fraud and identity work instead, which is real but covers a different risk than a cracked phone screen or a stolen laptop.
rental_note: No rental car coverage at all, primary or secondary. If you decline the counter's collision waiver with this card, nothing backs you up, so either buy the waiver, rely on your own auto policy, or pay for the rental with a card that actually covers it.

services.name: $0 fraud liability
services.detail: You are never held responsible for unauthorized purchases. No enrollment needed.

services.name: CreditWise
services.detail: Your FICO Score 8 from TransUnion on your statement and in the app, with the factors moving it. Discover offers this to non-cardholders too, so it is not really exclusive.

services.name: Social Security number alerts
services.detail: Get an alert if your Social Security number is found on the dark web, plus credit monitoring alerts on select changes to your TransUnion and Experian reports. It runs through CreditWise, which needs enrollment and is open to anyone over 18 with a valid SSN that matches a TransUnion profile.

services.name: Card Lock
services.detail: Lock the card in the mobile app if it is misplaced, lost or stolen. Some activity continues while it is locked, including returns, credits, payments, interest, balance transfers and other account fees. Usually only the primary cardholder or an account manager can lock or unlock it.

services.name: 24/7 customer service
services.detail: You can reach a live agent any time, though some specialized agents may not be available around the clock.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Their spending earns cash back into your account
Any purchase protection or travel coverage

additional_cards.note: Free to add, though you stay responsible for everything an authorized user charges.

timeline.text: When your own account moves to Capital One, new earning routes switch on that Discover never had: 5% on hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel, 5% on tickets and events through Capital One Entertainment, and up to 15% through Capital One Offers. Miles cards earn the same rates in miles. These only apply once your account has moved, and Discover's own product pages do not list them.

Capital One begins moving Discover card accounts onto its own platform on July 27, in waves running through 2027. Account numbers, existing earn rates, rewards balances, APRs and the Discover network branding all stay put, and migrated accounts also pick up the new Capital One earning routes. Redemption changes though: the gift card minimum rises from $5 to $25, and Pay with Rewards through Apple Pay goes away.

The Discover cardmember agreement is replaced by a Capital One one, effective June 30. New accounts run under the Credit Card Agreement for Discover by Capital One, N.A., and applications now open on capitalone.com. Discover no longer publishes a per-card rates and fees document. One agreement now covers the Discover line, and a separate one covers the Secured card.

Capital One completes its acquisition of Discover Financial Services. Discover Bank later merges into Capital One, N.A. The cards keep Discover branding, but the governing terms move to Capital One's own agreement in June 2026.
Price protection is discontinued, following the larger round of cuts earlier in the year.

Discover drops purchase protection, extended warranty, return guarantee, auto rental collision coverage and travel accident insurance across its consumer cards. This is why the protections section below is empty.
